name: Solar AR
desc: Broadband anti-reflection for 400-1100 nm.

name: Hot mirror
desc: Transmit visible light, reflect near-infrared heat.

name: Cold mirror
desc: Reflect visible light, transmit near-infrared.

name: Green band-pass
desc: Pass a narrow green band, block the rest.

name: 1064 nm notch
desc: Block a laser line at 1064 nm, transmit elsewhere.

name: Broadband mirror
desc: Reflect across the whole band.

name: Dual-band AR
desc: Anti-reflection in two separate bands.

name: Low-e window
desc: Transmit visible light, reflect infrared.

name: Broadband absorber
desc: Absorb everything: R and T near zero.

name: Black selective
desc: Solar absorber: dark in the visible, reflective in the infrared.

name: Neutral density
desc: Flat partial transmission across the visible.

name: Red colour
desc: Opaque structural colour that reflects red.

name: Telecom AR
desc: Anti-reflection over the 1525–1610 nm telecom band, all beyond the 1400 nm end of the training band.

name: Telecom pass band
desc: High transmission over 1500–1600 nm; what happens outside the band is left open.

name: 1550 nm notch
desc: Reject 1525–1575 nm and pass the infrared on either side.

name: SWIR mirror
desc: High reflectance over 1400–2200 nm in the short-wave infrared.

name: SWIR absorber
desc: Absorb the short-wave infrared over 1400–2200 nm.

name: 2 µm laser AR
desc: Anti-reflection over 1900–2100 nm for thulium and holmium lasers, 500 nm beyond the training band.

name: Deep-SWIR mirror
desc: High reflectance over 2000–2500 nm, the paper's furthest band from training.

name: Visible pass, SWIR reflect
desc: Transmit 380–700 nm and reflect 1500–2400 nm: one band inside the training range, one beyond it.
